### Lennette

> **Ambient real-time intelligence for your live conversations.**

Lennette is an invisible, real-time AI copilot designed to sit quietly beside you during interviews, meetings, and discussions. It listens to your microphone and system audio with zero latency, transcribing spoken dialogue, recalling relevant context, and surfacing suggested points and answers right when you need them.

---

### Bring Your Own Keys (BYOK)

Lennette is 100% user-owned and local-first. There are no proprietary intermediaries, data mining, or telemetry:

- **Any Cloud Provider**: Bring your own API keys for OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, Groq, and Deepgram.
- **Encrypted Local Storage**: API keys and credentials are stored inside an encrypted local vault protected by your operating system's keyring.
- **Local SQLite Database**: All transcripts, meeting summaries, and custom system prompts are kept exclusively on your local machine.
